items.role: Chair of the Board of Directors
items.verbatim_snippet: Mackenzie Health announced Fay Lim-Lambie, Dean of the Centre for Health Sciences at George Brown College, as the new Chair of the Board of Directors, taking over the post from Mark Falbo, President of Mircom Group of Companies. Stephanie Zee was concurrently named Vice-Chair, and several new members joined the board.

Alongside the chair transition, the board welcomed new members including Krista Collinson, Head of Direct to Consumer Division at Samsung, and Deryn Rizzi, Fire Chief and Director of Emergency Management with Mississauga Fire and Emergency Services and former Fire Chief of the City of Vaughan.

items.role: Vice President Digital Health and Chief Information Officer
items.verbatim_snippet: Purvi Desai joined Mackenzie Health as the Vice President Digital Health and Chief Information Officer, providing strategic leadership and oversight for the digital health portfolio, including clinical informatics, information technology and digital project management across all Mackenzie Health sites.

items.role: President and CEO of Mackenzie Health Foundation
items.verbatim_snippet: Mackenzie Health and Mackenzie Health Foundation announced the appointment of Nicole McCahon as the new President and CEO of Mackenzie Health Foundation, effective June 19, 2023.

Stephanie Zee was appointed Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors at its Annual General Meeting on June 13, while Mario Paura was appointed Chair of the Mackenzie Health Foundation board at its AGM on June 19; both had previously served as Vice-Chairs. Zee took over from outgoing chair Fay Lim-Lambie, and Ruby Philip-Katyal and Joby McKenzie were appointed Vice-Chairs of the Mackenzie Health board.

items.role: Chair of the Mackenzie Health Foundation board
items.verbatim_snippet: Mario Paura was appointed Chair of the Mackenzie Health Foundation board at its AGM on June 19.

Board Chair Stephanie Zee announced that President and CEO Altaf Stationwala, after more than 14 years of leadership, would be moving to become President and CEO at Unity Health Toronto, with his last day at Mackenzie Health being June 27, 2025.
Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer and Chief Nursing Executive Mary-Agnes Wilson was named to serve as Interim President and CEO until a permanent replacement was selected.

John Fursey, who recently retired as Senior Partner and Vice President at IBM Canada and had been a board member since 2023, was appointed Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors at its annual general meeting on June 19, succeeding outgoing chair Stephanie Zee.

items.role: Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors
items.verbatim_snippet: John Fursey, who recently retired as Senior Partner and Vice President at IBM Canada and had been a board member since 2023, was appointed Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors at its annual general meeting on June 19, succeeding outgoing chair Stephanie Zee. He aimed to use his extensive experience in financial management and leadership consulting to drive positive changes for Mackenzie Health and the community.

Dr. Rauchwerger was appointed Chief of Staff, bringing more than 15 years of progressive clinical leadership; he previously served for a decade as Chief and Medical Director of Emergency Medicine at Mackenzie Health, where he led system-level innovation and quality improvement initiatives, and was instrumental in launching the Emergency Department at Cortellucci Vaughan Hospital when it opened in 2021.

items.verbatim_snippet: Carmine Stumpo was appointed the new President and CEO of Mackenzie Health, effective April 13, 2026, ending Mary-Agnes Wilson's interim tenure that began following Altaf Stationwala's June 2025 departure.
